kernel.title: Pi-Kernel-Versionsverwaltung
kernel.desc: Verwaltet nur ~/.my-harness-desktop/pi. Version zur Installation wählen (neuer = Upgrade, älter = Downgrade); der Desktop berührt nicht das pi im PATH.
kernel.configDesc: Pi-Basis-Konfiguration bearbeiten (~/.pi/agent/settings.json). Häufige Schlüssel haben Beschreibungen; der Rest wird automatisch gerendert (Basis-Upgrades verlieren keine Felder).
kernel.customCli.title: Benutzerdefinierte pi-Basis
kernel.customCli.desc: Verwende eine pi-Basis aus einem selbst gewählten Verzeichnis (eigener Build oder angepasster Fork). Zwei Layouts werden erkannt: Paket-Quellroot (mit dist/cli.js) / npm-Installationsverzeichnis. Wirkt für neue Sitzungen; laufende Sitzungen werden zum Neustart markiert.
kernel.customCli.appliedWithPending: ✓ Aktiv — Version {{version}} · {{count}} laufende Sitzung(en) zum Neustart markiert
kernel.customCli.overrideHint: ⓘ Eine benutzerdefinierte Basis ist aktiv; Installationen schreiben nur in die Datenwurzel
kernel.fieldDescs.defaultProvider: Default model provider id (e.g. anthropic, openai, or a custom provider key in models.json)
kernel.fieldDescs.defaultModel: Default model id (provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5)
kernel.fieldDescs.defaultThinkingLevel: Default thinking level; affects reasoning depth and token cost
kernel.fieldDescs.enabledModels: Glob list (e.g. anthropic/*, openai/gpt-*); press Enter to add one. Empty = all available; non-matching models are hidden
kernel.fieldDescs.hideThinkingBlock: Hide the thinking/reasoning block in the UI (still participates in reasoning; display-only)
kernel.fieldDescs.thinkingBudgets: Token budget cap per thinking level; empty = unlimited
kernel.fieldDescs.steeringMode: How mid-stream steering messages are inserted: all = queue all, one-at-a-time = one at a time
kernel.fieldDescs.followUpMode: How consecutive messages queue: all = queue all, one-at-a-time = one at a time
kernel.fieldDescs.transport: LLM request transport: auto / sse (streaming) / http (non-streaming)
kernel.fieldDescs.httpIdleTimeoutMs: HTTP/SSE idle timeout (ms); reconnect on timeout. 0 = default
kernel.fieldDescs.httpProxy: HTTP/HTTPS proxy (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890); empty = no proxy
kernel.fieldDescs.compaction.enabled: Auto-compact context as it nears the context window
kernel.fieldDescs.compaction.reserveToke: Tokens reserved for the model reply (kept free after compaction)
kernel.fieldDescs.compaction.keepRecentT: Recent tokens kept unsummarized (the latest N tokens; only earlier ones are summarized)
kernel.fieldDescs.retry.enabled: Auto-retry failed LLM requests (network errors / 5xx / rate limits)
kernel.fieldDescs.retry.maxRetries: Maximum retry count (gives up beyond it)
kernel.fieldDescs.retry.baseDelayMs: Retry base delay (ms); actual delay grows exponentially as base * 2^attempt
kernel.fieldDescs.retry.provider.timeout: Per-provider request timeout (ms); overrides the global one
kernel.fieldDescs.branchSummary.reserveT: Tokens reserved for the summary when jumping across session-tree branches
kernel.fieldDescs.branchSummary.skipProm: Skip the extra prompt when summarizing branches (true = no summary instruction added)
kernel.fieldDescs.shellPath: Shell path for the bash tool (e.g. /bin/zsh); empty = system default
kernel.fieldDescs.shellCommandPrefix: Prefix prepended to shell commands (e.g. source venv/bin/activate &&)
kernel.fieldDescs.npmCommand: npm command argv; press Enter to add an argument (e.g. npx then --yes). Empty = use npm
kernel.fieldDescs.externalEditor: External editor command (e.g. code --wait) used for editing long text
kernel.fieldDescs.images.autoResize: Auto-resize images to the terminal's displayable width
kernel.fieldDescs.images.blockImages: Block image display (don't load images; saves bandwidth)
kernel.fieldDescs.terminal.showImages: Whether the terminal shows images (requires image-protocol support)
kernel.fieldDescs.terminal.imageWidthCel: Image display width in terminal columns; 0 = auto
kernel.fieldDescs.terminal.clearOnShrink: Clear and redraw the terminal after compaction (less residue)
kernel.fieldDescs.terminal.showTerminalP: Show progress for terminal tool execution
kernel.fieldDescs.defaultProjectTrust: Default trust policy for new projects (controls whether the agent may run project commands)
kernel.fieldDescs.quietStartup: Reduce startup output (skip changelog / version info)
kernel.fieldDescs.collapseChangelog: Changelog collapsed by default at startup
kernel.fieldDescs.trackingId: Anonymous analytics tracking id (auto-generated; can be cleared)
kernel.fieldDescs.theme: Terminal theme id (base TUI theme, not the desktop theme), e.g. dark/light
kernel.fieldDescs.treeFilterMode: Session tree display mode; controls which nodes show
kernel.fieldDescs.doubleEscapeAction: Action on double-Esc: fork / tree (open session tree) / none
kernel.fieldDescs.showHardwareCursor: Use a hardware cursor (terminal cursor rendering)
kernel.fieldDescs.showCacheMissNotices: Show a notice on prompt-cache misses (for debugging cache hit rate)
kernel.fieldDescs.warnings.anthropicExtr: Warn when the Anthropic API exceeds its quota
kernel.fieldDescs.lastChangelogVersion: Base version whose changelog was shown (auto-managed; don't edit)
kernel.fieldDescs.extensions: Base extension paths (e.g. ~/.pi/extensions/my-ext); press Enter to add one
kernel.fieldDescs.packages: Base resource-package sources (npm names or git paths). Object form {source, autoload, ...} is read-only here; edit settings.json directly
kernel.fieldDescs.skills: Skill directory paths; press Enter to add one
kernel.fieldDescs.prompts: Prompt template directory paths; press Enter to add one
kernel.fieldDescs.themes: Terminal theme directory paths (base TUI themes); press Enter to add one
